notes:
Summary: Enterprise evaluation focused on Private VPC deployment. Primary ask: full audit log export to customer SIEM (Splunk/QRadar), consistent log schema, retention to meet regulatory 7-year requirement for select audit trails, and integration with customer-managed KMS/HSM for key wrapping. Customer also wants detailed access logs for model invocations (who/which service), and provenance for rollbacks.

Recent timeline / activities:
- 2026-01-25: Initial inbound from partner; exchanged NDA.
- 2026-02-02: Intro call — AE (Ethan) + SE (Nina). Customer: security & infra architects (Leah K.). Discussed VPC architecture, basic SSO.
- 2026-02-18: Fireflies call (ff:meeting:4b2f8c9a) — customer requested Splunk forwarder + syslog over TLS. Action: provide sample syslog payload.
- 2026-02-28: Shared draft DPA (drive:/contracts/lighthouse/dpa-draft-2026-02-28.docx). Legal flagged residency clause for EU subsets.
- 2026-03-04: SE deep-dive (ff:meeting:9a1d3e7b) on KMS integration and envelope encryption; provided initial KMS policy template.
- 2026-03-08: Received internal security questionnaire, highlighted questions around access logs and log retention.

Customer requirements (detailed):
- SIEM export: push to customer Splunk over HTTPS or syslog/forwarder. Support for both agentless HTTP webhook + syslog over TCP/TLS.
- Log schema: canonical fields required: timestamp, request_id, model_name, model_version, route, tenant_id (pseudonymized), actor_id (pseudonymized), prompt_hash, response_hash, token_count, latency_ms, decision_reason (fallbacks), kv_cache_hit, policy_eval_id. Need canonical JSON schema + mapping for CSV ingest into Splunk.
- Access logs: record API key id/role, source IP (VPC egress), instance id, container id, and audit trail for admin actions (deploy, rollback, change routing). Admin actions must include user_id, SSO provider assertion id, and change diffs.
- Retention: primary audit logs 7 years for compliance scope A; operational logs 90 days by default. Need configurable retention windows per log class and export hooks to cold storage (S3 with lifecycle).
- KMS: integrate with customer-managed AWS KMS and support HSM-backed keys via external key wrapping. Key policy must allow Redwood service principal to encrypt/decrypt for ephemeral caches only; customer must retain key rotation control.
- SIEM schema mapping: security team wants sample mapping for Splunk sourcetypes and field extractions.

Quotes / paraphrases from customer:
- "We cannot accept black-box logs; need full schema and field-level guarantees." — Leah K., Security Architect.
- "Retention beyond 1 year is non-negotiable for audit trails; legal will block otherwise." — General counsel note in Gmail thread thread:1790023efgh.

Proposed Redwood deliverables to unblock:
- SIEM integration design doc + example ingestion payloads (syslog + HTTP JSON) — due 2026-03-15. (Drive: drive:/pocs/lighthouse/splunk-integration-design-v1.pdf)
- Sample log schema v1 (JSON schema) with field definitions and cardinality expectations.
- KMS integration runbook + key policy template for customer review.
- Retention/archival pattern: hot 90d, warm 2y, cold 7y export to S3 with immutability option.

Next steps and risks:
- Next step: Deliver SIEM design and schedule 60m security review for week of 2026-03-22.
- Risk: Legal/data residency clause for EU subfleet may require Private (on-prem) or regional VPC carve-outs — could increase cost and delay.
- Risk: Customer insists on HSM-backed KMS -> additional engineering for envelope integration and operational runbooks.

Short-term asks from AE/SE to Engineering: sample log payloads, retention config UI mock, and KMS policy example. Jira tickets created for FE UX and KMS work: RI-4521 (log export), SEC-1293 (KMS/HSM), see linked_support_tickets.
